# montecarlo_open_telemetry_key (Data Source)

An OpenTelemetry key is a key id and secret your agents send their OpenTelemetry traces with, to the one Agent Observability deployment it is scoped to. The secret is returned only when the key is created. A deployment can hold several keys, so create the new one before deleting the old one when rotating.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_id` (String) Id of the integration key, as returned when it is created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) When the key was created.
- `deployment_id` (String) The `AGENT_OBSERVABILITY` deployment the key sends traces to.
- `description` (String) What this key is for.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the key.
- `mcd_id` (String) Key id to present, as the `x-mcd-id` header or a client's `mcd_id` setting. The same value as `id`.
